description: Record chosen answers and return a compact client-held resume token, progress count and next statement. Call after each answer or batch and before pausing. Reuse the latest token to append or revise choices; a bare quiz_id starts an empty record. The token contains answers: save it privately in the client and never add it to public links. No server-side account or answer history is created.

question_id.description: Exact statement id returned for this quiz, not its number or a made-up id.

quiz_id.description: The exact quiz_id returned by axes_get_questions. Identifies the selected statements; does not store answers. Use the latest resume_token to preserve progress.

resume_token.description: Latest resume_token. It contains the recorded choices: keep it in the client, not in public links.

name: axes_record_answers
title: Save or revise quiz progress
